findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_guides, list_portfolios · Public sink: portfolio_returns, portfolio_risk, analyze_portfolio, find_guides, run_backtest · Destructive: analyze_portfolio, fund_history, run_backtest.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_guides, list_portfolios · Public sink: portfolio_returns, portfolio_risk, analyze_portfolio, find_guides, run_backtest · Destructive: analyze_portfolio, fund_history, run_backtest

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
